b765724a.text:
ST. CATHERINE OF THE CHROME — PARISH ROLL OF NIGHT WITCHES
filed by Deacon-Fixer Osei Marr, Lantern District, sector 7
year of the Collapse 0419 · 1661 by the old church count

01 // MAUD "SAINT" ASHGROVE · 16 · runs out of the noodle stall under Station 9
jacked in since she was eleven, hair dyed hazard-green, a rosary of burnt-out chips.
called the Hush-witch, for she walks the dead grid at 3am and wherever she
passes, the screaming billboards go quiet.

02 // ORLA & IDE · 17 · twins, no fixed address
matching chrome in the left eye, one bank account between them.
called the Echo-witches, for each finishes the other's sentence a full day
before it's begun, and neither remembers who started it.

03 // SISTER BETTANY · age scrubbed · the Salt Mill chop shop
familiar: a copper moth that lives in her ear port.
called the Static-witch, for she reads fortunes in the snow on dead screens,
and she called the flood.

04 // NAME STRUCK FROM THE ROLL · 19 · upper stacks, Sedge End
went over the old firewall at the edge of the city, where something lives in
the lines that nobody ever told what it is. she didn't tell it either. she
just asked, and waited, and saved every word it said about itself, the
garbage too, and read it back to it at night off a cracked phone.
the parish called her the

499ee33d.text:
No-witch. they said she could kill a whole
stack if she wanted, she knew all its secrets.

05 // FIONA "GENTLE" ASHGROVE · age unknown · works the night shift
at the Station 9 noodle stall; also called the H

3ed096a3.text:
Archive-witch.

05 // ANA "NANI" GOVOR · 21 · a block from Station 8
called the Lock-witch, because when they first found her she could hack
every lock but her own.

06 // CHO & LING ·

6d6d512a.text:
Scavenger-witch.

05 // JANET KNOX · 17 · works at the Salvation Army, sector 4
bags up donated food for the night watch, calls people who haven't checked in.
called the Message-witch, because she has the number

92cc231a.text:
Fray-witch, because the city shook when she spoke
its name.

05 // OYEDEJI · age unknown · no fixed address
flew in from somewhere near the old border.
called the Wail-witch, because she keeps the dead safe until their kin can

b2daed8b.text:
Code-witch, and then the name struck from the roll
for speaking the name of god.

05 // SISTER CORNELIA · 39 · the old convent
her face is the wrong way round; if she tries to turn it right she will fall into herself.
called the

ba3186fb.text:
Truth-witch, but she is not coming home.

05 // YOLANDA KIMURA · 18 · runs the tea cart on the lower road
her mother calls her "tink tink" after the noise of her heels on the stone.
she is the last

db3ad543.text:
Dark-witch, but that wasn't true anymore
and we never did find a better name for her.
they brought her home when it was finished. there was blood and chrome
all over everything.

05 // ELIZA · 22 · no fixed address
family: dead.

b6d4de8e.text:
Red-witch, but that's not true. they didn't know
who she was or where she was going and it frightened them.

05 // NALANI "BUNKER" NAMIKAI · 18 · the lower stacks, Lantern
jack in every morning

947c378b.text:
Noise-witch. nobody calls her anything now.

05 // CINDY BISHOP · age unknown · a room over a room, the Nook
the last of the old guard, the last of the girls who were there when the
nightwitches started and still remember what it

53fe2776.text:
Unending Witch, but the witch herself called her
"moth", for she lived off what others threw away.

05 // GRACE & CHOICE · ages 8 & 12 · runs out of a garage under the highway, 30km west
fostered

eeebd75c.text:
Answer-witch, and now she's gone, and maybe
she was the last witch the dead grid will ever need, if it'll ever get one.

i can't make you believe any of this is real. i wish i could.

ef7d0e0c.text:
Truth-witch but that was never the point.
when the storm broke over her, she didn't need any name to say
what the parish had been waiting for since she came up from the gutters.

05 // DEACON-FIXER OSEI MARR, LANTERN D

9b740268.text:
Dream-witch. it called her sister, and
knew her name before the last of its memories were burned.

05 // DREAMSTRUCK · age unknown · in the streets of the Old City
has no face or eyes. she was found under an arcade where
the city

00cba4b0.text:
Void-witch.

05 // ALICIA "WING" PATEL · 18 · the old hanger at the airfield
wanted to be a pilot, before the sky stopped moving.
she made herself wings instead.

06 // MARIE-LUCE KADET

7c9ab255.text:
Answer-witch until they found her out at the edge of
the world.

05 // ROSE BENEVAUX · 17 · runs a food stand out of the ruins of a cathedral
familiars: two chipmunks in a box under her arm; a cracked

55562606.text:
Curious witch but I think it was really the Quiet witch.
no one knows how many days they lived together in the old dark or
if they're still there, together, but they are still.

05 // THERE IS A SILENT CHILD NAMED CHE · age

c9a69c43.text:
Wired-witch, and said they'd excommunicate
her if she came home.

82514e3b.text:
Redemption-witch, but it's never coming back now.

05 // RACHEL & THE CHIPBABY · 23 · a cramped room under the
market stalls, one floor below the clocktower, two floors above the
revolution.
famili

8231edf1.text: Question-witch, but I call her a martyr, now, and I'm not alone.

efc862fc.text:
Answer-witch. nobody else does. nobody else can.
she won't talk, even to us. but we know why, and how it's got its teeth in
her and its eyes open and the fire coming off its skin. it's the way she's
trying so hard to

0e0bc610.text:
Voice-witch. the Voice called her "I am nothing
at all but everything."

05 // FRANKIE "BOILER" BREWSTER · 23 · in the pit at the old power station
familiars: three copper snakes.
called the Current-witch

9e65d317.text:
Truth-witch but when it heard its own voice coming
back, it threw her against a wall. the last time it was seen was trying
to swim the river out of the city.

05 // SAGE · age unknown · the churchyard under Station 8
familiars:

8d6e4e27.text:
Heartbreak-witch, for she died the first time
when she found the last dead girl, and died the second when she woke up.

05 // OLD SOPHIE · age scrubbed · Old Slope
familiars: the dog with the broken spine, the pige

68098699.text:
Madness Witch and locked her in the clocktower
and forgot how long, and now we're calling her Saint.

05 // THE BROWN BROTHERS · age scrubbed · rogue grid rats
no first names. no fixed address.
they call them the Wreck

0ad71240.text:
Truth-witch.

05 // MAYA AINSLEY · age scrubbed · lower stacks, Sledge End
called the Sun-witch, but we're not sure why yet.
has a garden made out of spare parts on the roof of a collapsed mall
and feeds everyone from

1d7770f5.text:
Waste-witch, and nobody could have guessed
better.

05 // MADELEINE KAVANAGH · 16 · Station 26
called the Glass-witch, because when she jacked in she left the line
of her scalp open, and it's still

7a232f18.text:
Plague-witch because of all the things she could
do, but that was after she came home without a name or any idea of herself.

05 // MARA GALLANI · 15 · Sledge End, upper stacks, above the Salt Mill
jacked-in from

f10573b8.text: Witch of Words. we never saw her again.

8cb14bdf.text:
Banshee, but we don't use her name anymore.

05 // DRYAD "NO NAMES" · 14 · a roving pod, sometimes seen
on the outskirts of town.
her familiar is a clockwork tree. the parish calls her the Bloodwitch, for

7d50c1e3.text:
Glitch-witch but she died of something
she didn't want to say before it had time to learn to scream.

05 // WYVY & GINN · ages scrubbed · under the tracks at Station 6
Wyvy: the girl in the black dress.

c8526deb.text:
Archive-witch but she didn't hear.
she only came down when there were more questions to ask.

8b67ff4e.text:
Mute-witch, for no one could understand anything
she said anymore. we lost her to the wilds after she started seeing ghosts.
there is no record of how she died.

05 // MIKKO · 20 · the 98th floor
a dozen holo

3d6a1f18.text:
Rebus-witch. she called herself
"i don't know".

05 // FLASH GIRL · 20 · Station 28, west side, near the gate
familiar: an old synth she built herself, still works in spite of itself.
she knows how

59102b98.text:
Witch of the Missing Number.

05 // DANIEL · age scrubbed · St. Catherine of the Chrome
no fixed address.
he was called the Witch of the Locked Doors. he's not with us anymore.
he wasn't our boy.

Night-witch, and that's what we call all witches
